scripts.migrate: echo 'Direct DB migration is removed; run bun run install:supacloud so SupaCloud Management API applies hosted migrations.' && exit 1
scripts.dev:server: echo 'dev:server is removed; SupAuth must run as a SupaCloud Function. Use bun run dev:function.' && exit 1
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter '@supauth/shared' build && bun run --filter '@supauth/sdk-typescript' build && bun run --filter '@supauth/sdk-auth-ui' build && bun run --filter '@supauth/auth-server' typecheck
scripts.test: bun run --filter '@supauth/shared' test && bun run --filter '@supauth/sdk-typescript' test && bun run --filter '@supauth/sdk-auth-ui' test && bun run --filter '@supauth/auth-server' test
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run --filter '@supauth/admin-console' build
